description: An expander for Personality that draws a filter response and gives it five trimpots to build one with; it goes immediately to the right of the Personality

params.text: Sets the dry level of the filter being built, 0 to 32 as the panel marks it, and hands it back to the Personality
Sets the level of pole one, 0 to 32 as the panel marks it, and hands it back to the Personality
Sets the level of pole two, 0 to 32 as the panel marks it, and hands it back to the Personality
Sets the level of pole three, 0 to 32 as the panel marks it, and hands it back to the Personality
Sets the level of pole four, 0 to 32 as the panel marks it, and hands it back to the Personality
Sets how much of the plot is shown: narrow, mid or wide
Chooses what the screen draws: Bode, the magnitude and phase against frequency, or Pole/Zero, the roots on the s-plane

notes: with no Personality immediately to its left this module draws nothing and its trimpots reach nothing
the Personality takes charge for one cycle whenever it is connected or a patch is loaded, so its own values land on these trimpots then; after that the trimpots drive the Personality
32 on a trimpot is a gain of 32 on that pole, so small settings go a long way and full ones can be very loud
to build a filter, set the five trimpots here, type a name on the Personality, and save that as a preset
the four pole feedback figures the plot uses have no control on this panel and are not sent over by the Personality, so they stay at zero here
